definitions.explanation: A boat or ship used commercially or traditionally for catching fish and other seafood.

examples.japanese: {漁船|ぎょせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧きた。
examples.english: The fishing boats returned to the harbor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧{漁船|ぎょせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{朝早|あさはや}く⟦{沖|おき}→沖：02144_oki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A small fishing boat went out to sea early in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいている→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、すべて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{漁船|ぎょせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{避難|ひなん}している→避難する：26827_hinansuru⟧。
examples.english: All fishing boats have taken shelter in the harbor because a typhoon is approaching.

notes:
A compound of {漁|ぎょ} (fishing, as an industry) and ⟦{船|せん}→船：09875_sen⟧ (vessel, ship). This is the standard formal term for fishing boats. Japan has a long maritime tradition, and {漁船|ぎょせん} frequently appears in news reports about fishing industry, maritime incidents, and weather warnings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {漁船|ぎょせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{沖|おき}→沖：02144_oki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: a fishing boat goes offshore
- {漁船|ぎょせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{転覆|てんぷく}→転覆：24054_tenpuku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a fishing boat capsizes
- {漁船|ぎょせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{乗組員|のりくみいん}→乗組員：21154_norikumiin⟧: fishing boat crew
- ⟦{小型|こがた}→小型：12460_kogata⟧{漁船|ぎょせん}: small fishing vessel

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {釣|つ}り{船|ぶね}: fishing boat — for recreational fishing charters
- ⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧: boat; ship — the general word for any watercraft
- {漁|りょう}: fishing — the act of commercial fishing itself
